summary: Steel tower of 24.4 m (80 ft) with a tower cabin, recorded for 1960 in an annual report; the Firetowers page spells it Mistatum; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 80-ft steel tower with a tower cabin built at the site
facts.agency: Saskatchewan Department of Natural Resources (as named in the 1960-61 annual report)
facts.status_note: No source describes the site today, so whether any part of the tower stands is not known.

events.note: A tower cabin was constructed at the Mistatim site, and an 80-foot steel tower erected, per the 1960-61 annual report.

evidence.supports: Canada Lookouts files the tower under a Hudson Bay Region heading
In 1960 a tower cabin was built at the site and an 80-foot steel tower erected
evidence.quote: A tower cabin was constructed at the Mistatim Tower site, and an 80-foot steel tower erected.

evidence.supports: The 1960 entry is cited to the Department of Natural Resources annual report for 1960-61
evidence.quote: Department of Natural Resources Annual Report, 1960-61

evidence.supports: The Department of Natural Resources is now called SERM
evidence.quote: Saskatchewan Department Of Natural Resources (now called Saskatchewan Environment and Resource Management or SERM)

evidence.supports: The Firetowers listing spells the tower Mistatum and gives its position

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Firetowers of Saskatchewan page spells the tower Mistatum; Canada Lookouts and the brief spell it Mistatim. The story uses Mistatim and gives the other spelling.

notes_for_editor: The thinnest of the three: one dated record (the 1960-61 annual report entry, quoted on Canada Lookouts) and a listing with coordinates. The brief had no events, so the 1960 build comes from that entry. The coordinates in the brief (52.95842, -103.38139) match the Firetowers listing (52-57-30.3, 103-22-53.0). The listing spells the name Mistatum. The brief's agency (SPSA) is not named in any source read; the story uses the Department of Natural Resources that the annual report names. Searches turned up only the Mistatim village and Big River-area fire pages, neither about this tower. A fuller record would need the Saskatchewan Archives or the annual reports themselves.
